entities.summary: Sir Thomas Edward Gordon was a Scottish soldier, diplomat, and traveller. A British Army officer, he fought in India, served as a diplomat in Tehran, and travelled across the Pamirs. He is primarily remembered as an author of several books about India, Persia, and Central Asia of the 19th century.
